customer: Caller, a veteran in Eastvale selling his electric car, said he's been hunting all over the house for the paper title, thinks it may have been lost in a move, and wanted to know how to replace it before his appointment.
agent: Customer asked how to replace a lost title in Eastvale before his appointment. Explained per 'Getting a duplicate title in Eastvale' that he can apply for a duplicate at any Eastvale motor vehicle office with his photo ID and registration, and that main offices print duplicates the same day, while by mail it takes 2 to 3 weeks. Reminded him to bring the duplicate to his appointment.
